question: Can a frequency-aware ordered-profile residual network improve C38 when it retains all294 descriptors and trains on all5508 FIT terrains?
data: Existing C38 FIT1024pixels/map and C10 DEV256pixels/map; terrain split unchanged; no official VAL used for training/selection.
teacher: runs/c38_1024_continue/best.pt; frozen; normalized FSPL-residual predictions cached from X only, no labels/masks.
inputs: All294 existing physical descriptors, plus deterministic nominal/empirical-phase Fresnel scales and geometric excess-length phases from the same128-point profiles.
physics_limit: Raster phase is a candidate hypothesis; sampled surface detour is not a recovered true multipath component.
tiny_fit: First4 distinct FIT terrains, one map each,1024 fixed sampled pixels/map;1000updates,1024batch; this is FIT-only capacity measurement, not validation.
full_fit: All three variants, same4096batch, max12000updates, all5508 FIT terrains, identical sampled point stream; monitor every1000. This expands original two-arm plan to use the three authorized cards; declared before any full-data candidate is launched.
selection: Minimum mean of two DEV RMSEs; zero-correction C38 baseline eligible; patience3000 after step4000.
promotion: Both sampled DEV gains>=0.10dB before complete DEV64 replay. Full612-terrain replay if both fullDEV64 gains>=0.10dB. Official VAL after fullTRAIN refit with DEV-selected fixed exposure.
large_gain_target: Substantial reduction toward<=1dB both bands; a screen pass is not target completion.
stop: No blind extension of a candidate if both training residual fitting and DEV have stalled.
hardware: Physical1/3/4 via full UUID in run_gpu.sh only
batch_choice: 4096: flat/attention gain throughput; conv4096 approximately same throughput as2048. Common batch preserves matched point exposure and updates.
